classification.difficultyReason: Match factored and translated cubic equations to supplied graphs by coordinating roots, crossing or touching behaviour, intercepts and end behaviour, and reject two unmatched options. These are routine linked feature comparisons with the equations and graphs supplied.

content.prompt:
Match each graph drawn with the equation of the cubic.

Hint: Not all equations have a matching graph.

answer.worked: The roots are $-1$, $1$ and $2$, and the $y$-intercept is $2$, matching graph (ii).

The graph crosses the $x$-axis at $-1$, $0$ and $1$, with its right end rising, matching graph (iv).
This decreasing cubic has a stationary point of inflection at $(2,2)$. None of the five graphs has these features.
The graph has a flattened crossing at $(-1,0)$ and a $y$-intercept of $2$, matching graph (iii).
The graph crosses at $x=-1$, touches at the repeated root $x=1$, and has $y$-intercept $1$, matching graph (i).
The graph crosses at $x=-1$, touches at the repeated root $x=2$, and has its right end falling, matching graph (v).
